## GEOquery

-   Get data from NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO).

```{r, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}

BiocManager::install("GEOquery")
```

-   Load GEOquery and helper libraries.

```{r, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
library(GEOquery)
library(tidyverse)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Download GEO data 

![](slide_images/mrna/Slide12.png){.slide-image-code}

<br>

```{r, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
gse <- getGEO("GSE19187")
```


------------------------------------------------------------------------

## GSE19187 metadata 

<br>

-   Extract sample metadata from the GEO object.

```{r, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
metadata <- pData(gse$GSE19187_series_matrix.txt.gz)
```

-   Select and rename the relevant variables.

```{r, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
metadata <- metadata %>%
  select(
    "age:ch1",
    "disease state:ch1",
    "gender:ch1"
  )

colnames(metadata) <- c("age", "disease", "sex")
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Clean up metadata 

<br>

```{r, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(age = as.numeric(gsub(" y", "", age)))
```

### Summarise disease by sex

```{r, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
metadata %>%
  group_by(disease, sex) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = disease,
    values_from = n
  )
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Summarise disease by age 

```{r, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
metadata %>%
  group_by(disease) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_age = signif(mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd_age = signif(sd(age, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(age = paste0(avg_age, " ± ", sd_age)) %>%
  select(disease, age) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = disease,
    values_from = age
  )
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Table 1 summary 

```{r, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
library(table1)

render_continuous <- function(x) {
  c(
    "",
    "Mean ± SD" = sprintf(
      "%.1f ± %.1f",
      mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )
}

table1(
  ~ age + sex | disease,
  data = metadata,
  render.continuous = render_continuous
)
```
